description: This file provides functionality to perform regex searches on files using ripgrep, including locating the ripgrep binary, executing searches, parsing results, and formatting output. It is a utility module for search operations within a VSCode extension or similar environment.

methods.name: truncateLine
methods.description: Truncates a line if it exceeds the maximum length, appending '[truncated...]' if truncated.

methods.name: getBinPath
methods.description: Locates the ripgrep binary within the VSCode installation directories or via checkBunPath.

methods.name: execRipgrep
methods.description: Executes the ripgrep command with specified arguments and returns the output as a string.

methods.name: regexSearchFiles
methods.description: Performs a regex search on files within a directory, parses ripgrep JSON output, filters results, and formats the search results as a string.
